brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the efficacy of HSK7653 (as an add-on to metformin) compared with linagliptin after 24 weeks, and the safety (up to 52 weeks) of HSK7653 in Chinese patients with Type 2 Diabetes who have inadequate glycemic control on diet/exercise therapy and metformin agent monotherapy.
brief_title: HSK7653 Metformin Add-on Study in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus

lead_sponsor.name: Sichuan Haisco Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd

official_title: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-Blind, Active-Controlled Trial of the Efficacy and Safety of Adding HSK7653 to Metformin in Chinese Patients With Type 2 Diabetes and Inadequate Glycaemic Control

primary_outcomes.measure: HbA1c Change From Baseline at Week 24
